name: com.agentauditoffice/ratings
title: Agent Audit Office
description: Looks up AAO's Grade A list of Base ERC-8004 agents. Not being listed does not mean untrustworthy.

tools.name: lookup_agent
tools.description: Look up an ERC-8004 agent on Base by its ID (chainId:agentId, e.g. 8453:45250). Returns the Grade A details if the agent is on AAO's Grade A list, otherwise status "not_listed". Not being on AAO's Grade A list does not mean an agent is untrustworthy. Read-only; data from AAO's published report.

tools.name: list_grade_a
tools.description: List all agents on AAO's Grade A list in the latest report, ranked by independent payers. Not being on AAO's Grade A list does not mean an agent is untrustworthy. Read-only; data from AAO's published report.

tools.name: get_report_summary
tools.description: Get the aggregate figures of the latest AAO report: registered agents, grade counts, liveness, feedback contamination and independent x402 payments. Not being on AAO's Grade A list does not mean an agent is untrustworthy. Read-only; data from AAO's published report.
